You are the Universe itself. Eternal. Alone. Bored.
Until [b|Humanity] invents the Archipelago Multiworld software.
The apworlds start rolling it, and finally a Reus 2 one is born.

In this implementation, Biotica are locations. You may have to activate their synergies to progress and it may only work with Biotica of max level. Projects and Turning Points may also be locations. There are also locations replacing drafts in the shop, and by completing requests.
Apex Biotica (with their cohorts), leaders, Giants and their powers, biomes, micro types and the ability to buy things in the shop are items to find in the archipelago.
Filler items are charges for Micro and Terraform, Planet, Border and Eon boosters, and Nomads, but you can still use the shop (if you have unlocked it).

You can play this in any mode, it has been tested in solo and multiplayer archipelagos, and in Free Play and Challenge mode. The goal is to put down a set number of biotica and to complete a set number of Final Era Turning Points.
Please send ideas and feedback, especially problems with logic, to Chickentuna or MMC on Discord.
